title: Plans
lede: Five plans for your whole job search: CVs, cover letters, job matching, alerts and interview practice. Prices in USD, taxes extra.
annualNote: Annual plans are paid upfront for 12 months at the price of 10. Allowances still renew monthly.

positioning.starter: Build a CV and discover opportunities
positioning.business: Support candidates in a shared workspace

card.textSessions: {count, plural, one {{amount} text session} other {{amount} text sessions}} a month
card.voiceMinutes: {count, plural, one {{amount} voice minute} other {{amount} voice minutes}} a month
card.contactSalesBody: Larger organizations, extra seats or candidates, SSO, custom integrations and service levels are arranged with our team under Business. Tell us what you need.
card.businessNotInApp: Business is arranged with our team and is not sold in the app.
card.trialAvailable: Free trial available. The store shows its length and the renewal price before you confirm.

autoRenewNote: Paid plans renew automatically every month or every year, at the price shown, until you cancel. You review the plan, the price and the renewal before anything is charged.
annualTermsNote: Annual billing is paid upfront and priced at ten monthly payments for twelve months. Allowances renew every month on your billing date and do not roll over.
taxesNote: Prices are in USD and exclude taxes.
storePricesNote: Prices on the cards come from your App Store or Google Play account, in your store’s currency.
comingSoonInApp: Buying a plan in the app is coming soon. Your current plan and allowances are not affected.
legacyNote: This plan is no longer sold. You keep its price and limits while it renews. Its career tools match {tier}.
freeRenewalNote: Free allowances renew each month on your account anniversary.

owner.website: Your plan is billed through the FlacronCV website and is managed there. It can’t be bought again in the app, so you are never charged twice.
owner.apple: Your plan is billed by the App Store. Change or cancel it in your App Store subscriptions.
owner.google: Your plan is billed by Google Play. Change or cancel it in your Google Play subscriptions.
owner.support: Your plan is managed by our support team. To change it, open a support request.

stateComingSoonDesc: Allowance is reserved in the plan; the feature is not released yet.
stateProviderDesc: Built, and works once its outside service (speech, maps or push messaging) is connected.
compareIntro: Usage rows renew monthly. Capacity rows are saved or active items. A feature marked "Coming soon" is not charged for until it is released.
usageVsCapacity: Usage allowances count completed operations each month. Capacity limits count items you keep at once; after a downgrade existing items stay readable, only new ones are blocked.
everyPlanNote: Every plan includes basic job browsing, manual profile editing, saved results, PDF export, source links, basic reliability flags and control over what you share.
pooledNote: On Business, CV versions, tracked applications, evidence items and portfolio pages are per candidate. Other Business usage is pooled.

rows.scenarioReports: Career and relocation scenario reports / month
rows.projectBriefInSkillReport: Job-ready project brief (inside a skill report)

delivery.immediate_optional: Optional immediate email, push and Telegram

definitions.documentCredits: One completed CV creation or tailoring, cover letter, bio or profile rewrite.
definitions.resumeAnalyses: One CV version compared with one job description.
definitions.actionPacks: One fit explanation, gaps, tailored CV, cover letter, checklist and next steps for one opportunity. The documents inside a pack are not charged again.
definitions.alertItems: One newly surfaced opportunity for you. Delivering the same item in the app, by email, push or Telegram does not multiply the debit, repeat appearances are free, and interview, application and billing reminders never use alert items.
definitions.textInterviewSessions: Up to ten questions, feedback and a final summary. Resuming the same session is not a new debit.
definitions.voiceMinutes: Recorded practice time, metered by the second. Transcription and normal session feedback are included.
definitions.skillReports: One target-role comparison with a learning plan and an optional project brief (no extra charge for the brief).
definitions.scenarioReports: A comparison of up to three career or relocation options.
definitions.coachingResponses: One completed AI reply in career coaching.
definitions.assistedForms: One supported application form prepared for your review. Submitting it is a separate step you approve.
definitions.mapSessions: One interactive map load and up to fifteen minutes of navigation, not every pan or zoom.
definitions.locationProfiles: One city with a radius, one defined region, or one remote-eligibility setup. The radius limit applies to local city searches.
definitions.savedSearches: One active saved search that keeps looking for new opportunities.
definitions.followedCompanies: One company you follow for new openings and news.
definitions.resumeVersions: One named CV kept in your account at a time. Deleting one frees a place.
definitions.trackedApplications: One application kept in your tracker at a time.
definitions.evidenceItems: One document, certificate, sample or link kept in your Evidence Vault.
definitions.portfolioPages: One active portfolio page you can share publicly or privately.
definitions.storageBytes: Space for your uploads and attachments across the whole account.
definitions.careerProfiles: Your one master profile that every CV, letter and match draws from.

chargingRules: Editing by hand, reopening results, cached match views and repeated downloads use no credits. A failed request returns its reserved credit. Included units are used before purchased ones.
